dbo.zkbi_tMuhasebe.instructions:
General-ledger accounting fact (muhasebe fişi). UNION with _Arsiv for full history.
METRIC:
- Net tutar / gider / gelir = SUM(ISNULL(Borc,0) - ISNULL(Alacak,0)).
ACCOUNT CLASS (mali tablo) — filter by first digit of HesapKodu OR the MaliTablo column:
- LEFT(HesapKodu,1)=N'1' assets, N'2' assets, N'3' liabilities -> BILANCO (balance sheet).
- LEFT(HesapKodu,1)=N'6' -> GELIR (income statement).
- LEFT(HesapKodu,1)=N'7' -> MALIYET (cost/expense accounts).
- Or use MaliTablo=N'1-BILANCO' directly (precomputed column).
DIMENSIONS:
- zTarih / EvrakTarihi: posting date.  HesapAdi: account name (LIKE N'%ELEKTRİK GİDER%').
- HsKod1..3 / AnaKod1: account hierarchy.  Sirket: company.  KurCinsi/Doviz: currency.
DEFAULT CLASS: a generic "muhasebe hesabı tutarı" / "mali tablo (toplam) tutarı" question (no class named) means MaliTablo=N'1-BILANCO'. The net Borc-Alacak across ALL classes is ~0, so an unfiltered sum returns 0 — you MUST add the MaliTablo filter. MaliTablo values: N'1-BILANCO' (bilanço/balance sheet, the default), N'2-GELIR TABLOSU' (gelir/income), N'3-MALIYET' (maliyet/cost). Only filter by LEFT(HesapKodu,1) when the question names a specific account-code class (e.g. '7').

dbo.zkbi_tMuhasebe_Arsiv.instructions:
Archive twin of zkbi_tMuhasebe. Identical columns. UNION ALL with the live table for any
total/period question. Same metric (Borc-Alacac) and HesapKodu/MaliTablo class logic.

dbo.zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz.instructions:
Sales & purchase movement fact (stok-cari hareket). UNION with _Arsiv for full history.
METRIC:
- Satış/alış tutarı TL  -> SUM(ISNULL(sNetTutar,0))
- Satış/alış tutarı USD -> SUM(ISNULL(NetTutarDoviz,0))
- Satış/alış miktarı    -> SUM(ISNULL(sMiktar,0))
MANDATORY MOVEMENT FILTER (always include both):
  LEFT(sHareketTuru,1) IN (N'H',N'I',N'J',N'K',N'N')   -- fatura-type movements
  AND LEFT(sGirisCikis,1)=N'2'   -- satış (sales);  use N'1' for alış (purchase)
DIMENSIONS (for "by X" / filters):
- sCariIsim / sCariKodIsim: customer name; sCariKod: customer code.
- sUlke: country (e.g. N'TÜRKİYE'); sCariIl: city (N'İSTANBUL', N'ANKARA', N'KONYA').
- rCariTip: N'A-Alici' (customer) | N'S-Satici' (supplier).
- rPlasiyerAdi: sales rep (N'MERKEZ', N'ALI CELIK', ...). Use LIKE N'%name%' if unsure.
- Stock hierarchy: rStokGrupAdi (N'MAMÜL',N'TICARI MAL',N'HURDA-ATIK',N'YARI MAMÜL'),
  rStokKodAdi1..4 (brand/series), sStokAdi (item), sYapAciklama (e.g. N'RENK:HAM (R1)' for color).
- sBelgeNo: document no.  zTarih: movement date.
- 'Müşteri/alıcı' sorularında her zaman rCariTip=N'A-Alici' filtresi ekle.
- 'Yurtiçi müşteri' müşteri tipini (rCariTip) ifade eder, sUlke filtresi değil.
- Ülke filtresinde her zaman LIKE kullanın ve Türkçe karakterleri koruyun: Türkiye için sUlke LIKE N'%TÜRK%'.
- 'Ülkeye satış' soruları rCariTip filtresi gerektirmez; rCariTip=N'A-Alici' yalnızca 'müşteri/alıcı' kelimesi geçtiğinde eklenir.
- ITEM vs GROUP: a specific product/service NAME (e.g. 'HIZMET STOGU', a part name) filters sStokAdi LIKE N'%name%'. rStokGrupAdi is ONLY for broad categories (MAMÜL, TICARI MAL, HURDA-ATIK, YARI MAMÜL) — don't use it for a specific item.

dbo.zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz_Arsiv.instructions:
Archive twin of zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz (older rows). Identical columns. Never query alone —
UNION ALL it with the live table for any total/history question. Same metrics & filters.

dbo.zkbi_tFinansCari.instructions:
Customer/supplier ledger (cari hareket). Single table (no archive).
METRIC:
- Net bakiye (balance) = SUM(ISNULL(BorcTL,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(AlacakTL,0)), grouped by CariKod.
  Total borç (receivable) bakiyesi: SELECT SUM(s) FROM (… GROUP BY CariKod) q WHERE s>0.
  Total alacak (payable) bakiyesi: same with WHERE s<0 (often reported as ABS).
- Toplam borç hareketi -> SUM(ISNULL(BorcTL,0));  toplam alacak -> SUM(ISNULL(AlacakTL,0)).
DIMENSIONS:
- CariKod (e.g. N'120-01-00277'); CariIsim / CariKoduAdi (use LIKE N'%name%').
- HareketTuru: movement type, e.g. N'B-Fatura', N'C-IadeFatura', N'D-Kasa',
  N'E-MusteriSenedi', N'G-MusteriCeki', N'H-BorcCeki'.
- Tarih / VadeTarihi: transaction / due date.  KurCinsi: currency.
- "Cari sayısı" / "müşteri sayısı" = COUNT(DISTINCT CariKod) with NO filter on rCariTip; "cari" covers all counterparties (buyers AND suppliers).
- Only filter by rCariTip when the question explicitly asks for a specific type (e.g. only alıcı or only satıcı).
- COUNT: "cari/müşteri sayısı" (number of customers) = COUNT(DISTINCT CariKod) over the whole table, NO rCariTip filter.

dbo.zkbi_tUretimIsEmri.instructions:
Production work-order fact (iş emri). Single table.
METRIC:
- Toplam iş emri miktarı  -> SUM(ISNULL(IsemriMiktar,0)).
- Üretilen miktar         -> SUM(ISNULL(UretimMiktari,0)).
- Kalan (remaining)       -> SUM(ISNULL(KalanUretimMiktari,0)).
DIMENSIONS:
- USK_Son_Durum: status N'Yeni' | N'Devam' | N'Tamamlandi'.
- MamulKodu / MamulAdi: produced item.  IsemriNo / IsemriTarih: work order no/date.
- CariUnvani: customer.  SiparisNo: order no.
- 'Açık iş emri' (open work order) = USK_Son_Durum = N'Devam' (not N'Acik').
- 'Kapanmış iş emri' (closed work order) = USK_Son_Durum = N'Tamamlandi'.
STATUS MAPPING: USK_Son_Durum values are N'Yeni' (new), N'Devam' (in-progress), N'Tamamlandi' (done). "Açık iş emri" (OPEN work orders) = USK_Son_Durum=N'Devam' ONLY (not Yeni). "Tamamlanan" = N'Tamamlandi'.
NAME FORMAT: mamul dimension specs are stored with a COLON and ASCII, e.g. '40 LIK DIKME FLANSI TIRNAKSIZ DIS CAP:50' (question may write it '(DIŞ ÇAP 50)'). Use LIKE N'%DIS CAP:50%' for such specs.

dbo.zkbi_tFinansKiymetliEvrak.instructions:
Negotiable instruments (kıymetli evrak: çek/senet). Single table.
METRIC: SUM(ISNULL(TutarTRY,0))  (TRY value).
FILTERS:
- EvrakTuru: N'1.(-) Borc Cekleri' | N'2.(-) Borc Senetleri' | N'3.(+) Musteri Cekleri'
  | N'4.(+) Musteri Senetleri'.  (+) = portfolio receivable, (-) = payable.
- Durumu: status N'Beklemede' (pending/portfolio) | N'Odenmis' (paid/cleared).
- "Portföydeki / bekleyen müşteri çekleri" = EvrakTuru=N'3.(+) Musteri Cekleri' AND Durumu=N'Beklemede'.
- BankaAdi, VerenCariUnvan, Kur/KurCinsi, zGirisTarihi available as dimensions.
- Always filter EvrakTuru with exact enum (= N'3.(+) Musteri Cekleri'), never LIKE.
- "Payı / yüzdesi / oranı" within kıymetli evrak: denominator = SUM(TutarTRY) WHERE Durumu=N'Beklemede' (all pending instruments), numerator = the requested subset also with Durumu=N'Beklemede'.

dbo.zkbi_tStokDepoBakiye.instructions:
Warehouse stock BALANCE snapshot (current, not date-filterable). Single table.
METRIC:
- Bakiye miktarı -> SUM(ISNULL(BakiyeMiktari,0)).
- Bakiye tutarı (SAF maliyet) -> SUM(ISNULL(BakiyeTutariSAF,0)).
Use this for "current/snapshot stock balance"; use zkbi_tStokDepo when the question
specifies a date/period. DIMENSIONS: DepoAdi (N'GENEL DEPO'), rStokGrupAdi, StokAdi, Birim.

dbo.zkbi_tStokDepo.instructions:
Warehouse stock MOVEMENTS (depo hareket), date-filterable. Single table.
METRIC:
- Net stok miktarı = SUM(ISNULL(GirisMiktari,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(CikisMiktari,0)).
- Net stok tutarı  = SUM(ISNULL(GirisTutari,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(CikisTutari,0)).
- Değerli stok (SAF cost) = SUM(ISNULL(SAF,0)*(ISNULL(GirisMiktari,0)-ISNULL(CikisMiktari,0))).
- Balance "as of a date": add WHERE zTarih<='YYYY-MM-DD' (movements up to the cutoff).
DIMENSIONS: StokAdi, Birim, DepoKodu/DepoAdi, rStokGrupAdi (N'MAMÜL',N'TICARI MAL'), Sirket.

dbo.zkbi_tFinansKasa.instructions:
Cash register ledger (kasa). Single table.
METRIC: SUM(ISNULL(TutarTRY,0))  (kasa bakiyesi / TRY).
FILTERS: KasaKoduAdi/KasaAdi (LIKE N'%MERKEZ KASA%'), Tip (e.g. N'A-Devir'),
GirisCikis, Tarih, KurCinsi, HesapAdi, PlasiyerAdi.

dbo.zkbi_tNakitAkim.instructions:
Cash-flow fact (nakit akım). Single table.
METRIC: SUM(ISNULL(TUTAR,0)).
FILTERS:
- TIP: N'GELIR' (inflow) | N'GIDER' (outflow).
- TUR: category N'CEK' | N'FATURA' | N'MAAS' | N'SIGORTA' | N'VERGI'.
- Sirket, BankaAdi, BelgeNo, TARIH as dimensions.
- 'Durum sayfası' (status page) → filter TUR = N'CEK'.
- When a question references a page/screen name, map it to the corresponding TUR value, not to date filters.

dbo.zkbi_tDovizKurlari.instructions:
Exchange-rate fact. Kod (joins to zkbi_tDovizCinsi.Kod), rate columns, date. Use for
currency-conversion questions.

dbo.zkbi_tDovizCinsi.instructions: Currency dimension. DovizCinsi (TRY/USD/EUR), Kod, Adi. Join target for currency lookups.

_connection_meta.instructions:
=== CONNECTION INSTRUCTIONS ===
[ENRICHMENT ONLY]
This is the AKOS ERP analytics model (Turkish manufacturing). Every fact table is
a flattened "zkbi_" view. Pick the FEWEST tables that answer the question — usually
ONE fact table. Route by the business domain of the question:

TABLE ROUTING (question intent -> table):
- Satış / sales / ciro / satış tutarı / satış miktarı / müşteriye satış / ülke-il bazlı satış,
  AND Alış / satınalma / purchase / tedarikçiden alış:
    -> zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz  (+ zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz_Arsiv, ALWAYS UNION both)
- Cari hareket / borç / alacak / bakiye / receivable / payable / cari ekstre / tahsilat:
    -> zkbi_tFinansCari
- Muhasebe / gider / gelir / bilanço / mali tablo / hesap / P&L / maliyet hesabı (7) / kâr:
    -> zkbi_tMuhasebe  (+ zkbi_tMuhasebe_Arsiv, ALWAYS UNION both)
- Üretim / iş emri / mamul / üretim miktarı / kalan üretim:
    -> zkbi_tUretimIsEmri
- Kıymetli evrak / çek / senet / portföy / müşteri çeki / borç çeki / bekleyen evrak:
    -> zkbi_tFinansKiymetliEvrak
- Nakit akım / cash flow / gelir-gider akışı / vergi / maaş / sigorta ödemesi:
    -> zkbi_tNakitAkim
- Stok / depo / stok bakiye / depo miktarı / stok devir / giriş-çıkış:
    -> zkbi_tStokDepo (movements, date-filterable) or zkbi_tStokDepoBakiye (snapshot balance)
- Kasa / kasa bakiyesi / nakit kasa / merkez kasa:
    -> zkbi_tFinansKasa
- Döviz / kur / exchange rate:  -> zkbi_tDovizKurlari, zkbi_tDovizCinsi

ROUTING HINTS (pick the RIGHT table, not more):
- "satış" and "alış" use the SAME table (zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz); they differ ONLY by
  the sGirisCikis filter ('2'=satış, '1'=alış). Do NOT add other tables.
- TL amount vs döviz/USD amount: if the question says "USD"/"dolar"/"döviz" use the
  *Doviz amount column; otherwise use the TL amount column.
- Bakiye (balance) questions on cari = net of Borç-Alacak grouped by CariKod, then
  filter (>0 = borç/receivable, <0 = alacak/payable). Do NOT just SUM one column.

ROUTING PRIORITY — METRIC NOUN WINS over topic/scene prefixes:
A question may open with a topic/page name that does NOT decide the table. Route by
the METRIC NOUN (the quantity actually asked for), which is usually the LAST noun
phrase before "nedir/kaç/toplam". Ignore leading scene-setters like "Nakit akımdaki…",
"Durum sayfasındaki…", "… raporundaki…".
  - "...CARI BAKIYESI / borç bakiyesi / alacak bakiyesi"  -> zkbi_tFinansCari
    (net BorcTL-AlacakTL grouped by CariKod; borç = s>0, alacak = ABS of s<0),
    EVEN IF the question starts with "Nakit akım..." or similar.
  - "...STOK tutarı / stok değeri / stok bakiyesi"  -> zkbi_tStokDepo / zkbi_tStokDepoBakiye,
    EVEN IF prefixed by "nakit akım" etc. ("stok değeri" = SUM(SAF*(Giris-Cikis))).
  - "...çek / senet" as the metric  -> zkbi_tFinansKiymetliEvrak; but a "çek
    GELIR/GIDER" cash-flow amount or "gelir-gider farkı" -> zkbi_tNakitAkim
    (TUR=N'CEK', TIP=N'GELIR'/N'GIDER'; a "fark" = GELIR minus GIDER).
  - Only route to zkbi_tNakitAkim when the MEASURED quantity itself is a cash-flow
    line (TUTAR by TIP/TUR) — not merely because "nakit akım" appears as context.
[/ENRICHMENT ONLY]
[SQL GEN]
GLOBAL SQL RULES (MSSQL / T-SQL):
- Tables that have an "_Arsiv" twin (zkbi_tStokCariAnaliz, zkbi_tMuhasebe) hold only
  recent rows; full history = current UNION ALL archive. ALWAYS wrap as:
    FROM (SELECT ... FROM dbo.<tbl> UNION ALL SELECT ... FROM dbo.<tbl>_Arsiv) t
  (select the same explicit column list on both sides; do NOT use SELECT * if the
  twins have different column counts).
- Wrap every summed numeric in ISNULL(col,0) so NULLs don't void the SUM.
- Date filters use the zTarih column (datetime). Year: YEAR(zTarih)=2025; month:
  MONTH(zTarih)=1; range: YEAR(zTarih) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025; cutoff: zTarih<='2026-06-12'.
- TURKISH-CHARACTER TEXT (verified against the data; folding is INCONSISTENT, so match loosely):
    * The dotted/dotless I (İ, ı) is USUALLY stored as plain ASCII I (e.g. 'BASLIK', 'TICARI', 'TÜRKIYE'). Fold İ/ı -> I in your literal.
    * The OTHER Turkish letters Ç Ş Ğ Ü Ö are OFTEN PRESERVED — especially in HesapAdi, sCariIsim, CariIsim, rStokGrupAdi (e.g. 'MAMÜL', 'YARI MAMÜL'), and sUlke (e.g. 'GÜRCISTAN'). Keep them as-is.
    * MamulAdi / sStokAdi are MOSTLY folded to pure ASCII (e.g. 'BASLIK SAPKALI', 'HIZMET STOGU'), but a few rows keep Ç/Ş — so prefer LIKE over exact equality.
    * WHEN UNSURE, do NOT use exact equality on a Turkish name. Use LIKE N'%<distinctive ASCII-core fragment>%' (fold the I's, drop the uncertain Ç/Ş/Ğ/Ü/Ö from the fragment) so the row matches regardless of how it was folded.
    * Specific verified values: country = sUlke LIKE N'%TÜRK%' (Ü kept, İ->I; NOT 'TURKIYE'); stock groups use 'MAMÜL'/'TICARI MAL'/'HURDA-ATIK'/'YARI MAMÜL'.
- Return a single scalar aliased AS t for "toplam/total" questions:
    SELECT SUM(ISNULL(<amount>,0)) AS t FROM ...
- Match the test's RESULT (the number), not its exact SQL text.
- DATA SPANS 2020-2026. When the question NAMES a year or range (e.g. '2024', '2023-2025 dönemi'), APPLY the filter (YEAR(zTarih)=2024 or YEAR(zTarih) BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025). When it names no period, sum all rows.
- TOTAL/SUM questions: write the aggregation DIRECTLY in ONE query (SELECT SUM(<metric>) ... WHERE <filters>). Do NOT first run an exploratory SELECT of dimension columns (rStokKodAdi*, names) to 'look at the data' — the amount columns (e.g. sNetTutar, NetTutarDoviz, TUTAR, Borc/Alacak) EXIST in the schema even if a probe query didn't select them. A dimension-only result is NOT evidence that the metric is missing.
[/SQL GEN]
